title: The Jack Benny Program
identity_notes: Mixed historical subset showing Jack Benny’s evolution from sponsor-led musical/variety programs in 1932-34 to the ensemble situation-comedy/variety format of the 1941-42 Jell-O season. The frozen 51-object GRH container is not a continuous run.

eras.label: Canada Dry Program
eras.notes: NBC Blue sponsor-led musical program with light comedy.

eras.label: Jell-O Program 1941-42
eras.notes: NBC Red ensemble comedy/variety season; January 18 is a music-only replacement broadcast.

historical_context.title: Evolution from musical variety to character-based situation comedy
historical_context.description: The preserved subset documents Benny’s transition from sponsor-led musical/variety formats toward the ensemble radio-persona comedy associated with the mature program.

historical_context.title: Sponsor-driven program eras
historical_context.description: Canada Dry, Chevrolet and Jell-O define distinct preserved program eras and format histories in this snapshot.

historical_context.title: Pearl Harbor interruption
historical_context.description: The December 7, 1941 Jekyll/Hyde broadcast was interrupted by news bulletins following the attack on Pearl Harbor.

historical_context.title: Military-base wartime broadcasts
historical_context.description: The 1942 season includes broadcasts from March Field, the Presidio, a San Diego Marine base, Mather Field and Santa Ana Air Base.

historical_context.title: Carole Lombard memorial replacement
historical_context.description: The regular comedy program was canceled and replaced by music following Carole Lombard’s death.
